dimensions.label: manual transmission
dimensions.description: A type of transmission system in vehicles where the driver manually shifts gears using a clutch and gear lever. Requires driver input to change gears, offering more control and efficiency but less convenience than automatic transmissions.

dimensions.label: automatic transmission
dimensions.description: A type of transmission system in vehicles that automatically changes gears without driver input, using a torque converter and planetary gear sets. Designed for convenience and ease of use, often at the expense of driver control and fuel efficiency compared to manual transmissions.

dimensions.label: rebuilt transmission
dimensions.description: A transmission that has been disassembled, repaired, and reassembled, often to restore functionality after wear or damage. May involve replacing worn parts, cleaning, and re-greasing. Often considered a cost-effective alternative to buying a new transmission, but quality can vary depending on the rebuild shop.
